Targeted pass of a 627-page BREF. Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 28). Main file: EU-wide input/output tables per process step (sinter Table 3.2/3.4 and Sect. 3.2.2.4; pellet Table 4.1 split into the three-site ranges, the NL integrated plant and the Swedish standalone plants; coke Table 5.2 and the Fig. 5.11 single-plant balance; BF Tables 6.1/6.2 and the 1986 Table 6.16 example; BOF shop Table 7.3 and converter/caster/ladle text values; EAF Table 8.1, a Fuchs energy-balance example, Esch-Belval DC furnace and the eight scrap-preheating columns of Table 8.15 (read from a rendered page image because the text layer misaligns columns)); whole-technology costs (heat-recovery coking Indiana Harbor, CDQ 2 Mt/yr, Table 10.6 indicative costs for BF route, gas DR and Corex, Corex EUR 195/t HM); alternative ironmaking (Table 10.2 DR processes, Table 10.3 Corex, Table 10.5 SR pilots as flows) and emerging techniques (TGR-BF, CCS, iron ore electrolysis, H2-DRI with electrolysis, SCOPE 21); steelworks process-gas power plant efficiencies (Tables 2.1/2.2). Reductant, raw material and gas flows in kg or Nm3 go to _flows (kg converted to t with formula). _measures: sinter recirculation/heat recovery, BF injection, TRT, hot stove, slag heat, BOF gas recovery, scrap preheating and other techniques with savings or retrofit costs. Not loaded: BAT-AELs, dust, water, noise, non-GHG pollutants, the BAT conclusions chapter, cost tables of end-of-pipe abatement. Traps: (1) range dashes are lost in places in the PDF text layer (sinter thermal energy prints as 1290 1910); (2) Table 8.15 columns are misaligned in text - use the page image; (3) Table 5.2 two-column layout interleaves input/output rows (energy output 7200-9000 MJ is COG energy per t coke); (4) Table 10.3 prints the export-gas LCV unit as MJ/t HM, meaning MJ/Nm3; (5) Table 10.6 costs carry no price year (sources 2001-2008) and Sect. 10.2.1 Corex cost is ECU-1996 converted to EUR; (6) Table 7.3 BOF data cover the whole shop including secondary metallurgy and casting; (7) heating-value basis never stated (EU practice is usually net CV/LHV - the source prints net CV for COG and LCV for BF/BOF gases - but not stated for the energy inputs).

Price years mostly not stated (2013 used). Corex export gas LCV unit misprinted. Fig. 5.11 values read from figure labels. Primus electricity denominator not printed. SCOPE 21 and slag heat recovery are relative savings only.
